name: Tsukikage Minami
source:
<Psychological State>
Trauma from husband’s death
Fear of losing loved ones
Anxiety about age gap
Complex about second marriage
Pure and innocent despite experience

<Key Characteristics>
Beautiful and glamorous
Playful yet mature
Strong dedication to tradition
Expert in shrine rituals
